name: 91730 · Rch Cucamonga, CA
findings: ZIP 91730 (Rch Cucamonga) has 316 nonprofit organizations. 94 of them (30%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 76 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (37% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 91730 (Rch Cucamonga) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
